windows-gfx1101.blocked_reason: Same host-wide Windows toolchain blocker as windows-gfx1201 (same physical machine, same TheRock clang-cl): full-SLAM binary crashes at startup in boost.serialization static type-registration (0xC00000FD infinite recursion in oserializer<KeyFrame>::save_object_data) BEFORE any GPU call. Confirmed GPU-independent and host-wide (independent of static/dynamic boost, -O0, and the Pangolin viewer). gfx1101 GPU itself is proven by other passes (e.g. libSGM). Not a port defect; needs a boost-header patch for the clang-MSVC ABI, MSVC cl.exe for the serialization TUs, or a fixed ROCm clang.

windows-gfx1201.blocked_reason: Full-SLAM gfx1201 GPU run blocked by a clang-cl + boost.serialization toolchain miscompilation (not a port defect): static type-registration recurses infinitely (0xC00000FD in oserializer<KeyFrame>::save_object_data) at startup before any GPU call. CONFIRMED independent of static-vs-dynamic boost (rebuilt the whole boost+PCL stack as x64-windows-static-md, single static boost.serialization, still crashes), of -O0, and of the Pangolin viewer (headless build crashes identically). Same code is GPU-validated and clean on Linux gfx90a+gfx1100. Full SLAM stack now BUILDS+LINKS cleanly on Windows static-md (commit 57212e2). gfx1201 GPU independently proven by the libsgm-stereo PASS on record. Needs a boost-header patch for the clang-MSVC ABI, MSVC cl.exe for the serialization TUs, or a fixed ROCm clang. See notes.md 2026-06-16.
